en.title: Implement a Rate Limiter
en.description:
Rate-limit requests by key. The original problem allows fixed-window or sliding-window, requiring only consistency with the examples; this site explicitly uses a fixed window: the window number is floor(timestamp/window), and each key may have at most limit requests allowed within one window number. Rejected requests do not consume quota.

The parts marked 'added by this site' and the standard input/output protocol were explicitly compiled by this site; they do not mean the original problem has other unstated rules.
en.input: The first line contains window limit q; then q lines of timestamp key. Added by this site: timestamp is a non-negative integer and non-decreasing, and key contains no spaces; 1≤q≤200000, 1≤window≤10^9, 1≤limit≤10^5.
en.output: For each request, output ALLOW or REJECT, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: First separate each rule of the original problem from the input conventions added by this site, then choose a suitable data structure.
